  • Ability to use logic and reason to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions

  • Experience with Greentree ERP software, considered an advantage.
  • Experience with Freight management and Logistics, will be considered an advantage

job.description:
Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Collect the truck from the Sydney depot early in the morning

  • Current MR driver's licence

  • Previous delivery driving experience preferred
  • Physically fit and capable of undertaking frequent manual handling and lifting of heavy meat products (approximately 50–60 kg)
  • Temporary assignment to cover an employee's period of leave
  • Immediate or short-notice availability preferred.

job.title: Site Manager - Charleville
job.description:
About RWM
Regional Workforce Management (RWM) is proudly Australian-owned, dedicated to connecting businesses with tailored recruitment and workforce management solutions since 2000. Formerly FIP Group, we’ve spent over two decades supporting the backbone of Australia - the food, agriculture, forestry and fisheries industries. By blending local expertise with a national reach, we deliver reliable and committed people who help businesses grow, thrive and stand strong.

What started as a small operation helping local businesses quickly grew into something much bigger. Our founders’ ability to connect with people - sharing experiences, solutions and hope – helped forge strong bonds with businesses and communities alike. As we expanded from labour hire to permanent recruitment and into connecting skilled workers from across the borders, our mission has remained the same: to provide real solutions that save Australia’s food and agriculture business time and resources.

We are powered by PeopleIN - Australia's largest ASX-listed family of workforce solutions brands.

The Opportunity
We are seeking a Site Manager to work onsite at one of our client's locations, Charleville.

In this role, you will be responsible for the following:

  • People welfare, including onboarding, probationary checks and discussions, issuing warning and termination letters, and employee retention
  • Payroll reconciliations regarding timesheet management
  • PLS (Pacific Labour Scheme) worker mobilisation
  • Transporting employees to clinics, in the case of an incident
  • Reports for VEVO checks
  • Management of clients and employees
  • Attendance management

What You Will Need
To be successful in this role you will have a drive to deliver and be a highly organised individual. You will be passionate about helping others succeed and be committed to this role.

You will also:

  • Have experience managing people and teams
  • Administration/HR/payroll experience is highly desirable
  • Have a Drivers licence and vehicle
  • Be willing to obtain a Police Check
  • Be willing and able to be vaccinated against QFever

If this sounds like you, APPLY NOW!

Please note only successful applicants will be contacted.

job.title: General Labourers and RF Scanner Operators
job.description:
About the Role
We are looking for General Labourers and RF Scanner Operators to join our client, a leading Australian beef supplier, based in Veradilla, QLD. You will be working in a production environment within a cold and freezer setting, as part of a supportive team.
  • Permanent Employment | Morning shift- $29.93 per, Afternoon shift - $34.42 per hour incl 15% loading
  • Location: Veradilla, QLD 4347
  • Roster: Rotating roster (10 hr days), 4 days a week | Morning shift and afternoon shift
Labourer:
  • Complete manual loading and handling of products, including loads up to 27.5kg where required
  • Follow workplace procedures for safety, quality and product handling
  • Work efficiently in chilled and freezer environments
  • Complete tasks accurately and work collaboratively within a fast-paced team environment
RF Scanners:
  • Operate RF and barcode scanners to accurately pick, scan and process products
  • Follow workplace procedures for safety, quality and product handling
  • Work efficiently in chilled and freezer environments
  • Complete tasks accurately and work collaboratively within a fast-paced team environment
Additional information
  • Q-Fever vaccination required
  • Permanent employment with a consistent rotating roster
  • PPE provided, including freezer jacket and boots
  • Training and development opportunities
About RWM Group  
RWM Group is an Australian owned specialist recruitment and workforce management company with both local and international talent solutions. RWM Group is part of PeopleIN, the largest ASX-listed talent solutions company in Australia and New Zealand.  
 
How to apply  
If you meet these criteria and are eager to advance your career, click the 'Apply' button below to submit your updated resume.  

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and all applications are treated with complete confidentiality. We thank you for your application, however, due to the volume of applicants only successful applicants will be contacted. A full list of all vacancies within RWM Group can be found on our website https://www.rwmgroup.com.au/
